title: Easy Free Throws to Finish
description: A relaxed set of free throws at the very end of practice, closing on a positive, low-pressure note while reinforcing the shooting routine.

content.objective: Close practice on a calm, positive note while reinforcing a consistent free-throw routine.
content.setup: Players line up at the free-throw line, one shooting at a time.
instructions: Shoot five relaxed free throws using the same routine as always.
Rotate to the next player after their five attempts.
No pressure or counting toward a game — just calm, quality repetition.
Finish with everyone taking one 'last shot' together to end practice.
coachingPoints: Keep the same calm routine as any other free throw.
Use this as a moment to reinforce good habits, not to critique misses.
End on a positive note regardless of makes or misses.
commonMistakes: Rushing through to leave practice sooner.
Turning it into a stressful competition when the point is to relax.
Rushing through it to finish practice sooner.
content.safety: Keep the line organised so only one shooter is at the line at a time.
